title: Generated: Read a county-capital register

prompts: After seven days, independently explain: Identify Liberia's fifteen county-capital pairs in a name register, without inferring geographic locations from entry order.
Apply the idea to a new context and justify the evidence or calculations used. This is a request for a governed retention task, not a scheduled or scored item.

scenes.title: Read a county-capital register
scenes.learnerAction: Read the county-capital pairs; distinguish county names from capital names without inferring geography.

content.body: This is a name register, not a geographic map. Its order shows no location, neighbours, direction or travel route. County-capital names are pinned repository data awaiting authoritative-source attestation before release.

scenes.title: Identify administrative names
scenes.learnerAction: Identify the capitals of Montserrado and Nimba using the register, and compare them with well-known cities.

content.body: Use the register to distinguish a county from the city named as its administrative capital. The largest or best-known city need not be the capital.

accessibility.textAlternative: Use the register to distinguish a county from the city named as its administrative capital. The largest or best-known city need not be the capital. Which city is Montserrado County's capital? Options: Bensonville; Monrovia. Which city is Nimba County's capital? Options: Sanniquellie; Ganta.

items.prompt: Which city is Montserrado County's capital?

options.feedback: Bensonville is the county capital. Monrovia is the national capital, located in Montserrado.
Compare this claim with the model and its evidence.

items.prompt: Which city is Nimba County's capital?

options.feedback: Sanniquellie is the county capital. A well-known trading city such as Ganta is not therefore the county capital.
Compare this claim with the model and its evidence.

scenes.title: Compare the names independently
scenes.learnerAction: Write how a county differs from its capital and explain why the register cannot establish a travel route.

content.body: The register pairs Bong with Gbarnga and Montserrado with Bensonville. Compare the administrative units; do not infer their geographic positions from the text order.

prompts.prompt: Explain how Bong and Gbarnga refer to different administrative units, using the register.
Can the order of these entries show which counties a road crosses? Explain what geographic source is missing.

scenes.title: Limit a claim to its evidence
scenes.learnerAction: Select evidence that supports administrative pairings and excludes unsupported travel claims.

content.body: Worked reasoning: a county-capital register supports administrative name pairings. It does not show borders, direction, distance, population or routes. A scaled geographic map and current road information would be needed to plan travel.

accessibility.textAlternative: Worked reasoning: a county-capital register supports administrative name pairings. It does not show borders, direction, distance, population or routes. A scaled geographic map and current road information would be needed to plan travel. Synthetic register-interpretation exercise. Each entry pairs a county name with its capital name. Entry order cannot establish a road route or neighbouring counties. Consecutive entries must be neighbouring counties. Which statements correctly describe the evidence this register provides?

scenes.title: Request the missing geographic evidence
scenes.learnerAction: Name Bong's capital, state what the register establishes, and request the geographic and current road sources needed for delivery.

content.body: Synthetic task: a school must send supplies to Bong County's office. It has the name register, but no map, current contact list or road data.

prompts.prompt: Explain why knowing Gbarnga is Bong's capital does not tell you which counties a delivery road crosses.
